title: 第17章 仙女师姐讲道万人空巷第18章 三灵分离惊艳全场
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
当林渊安然无恙地从分局大门走出来时，等在路灯下的顾小北，那颗悬在嗓子眼的心脏才终于落了回去。
她快步冲了上去，到了林渊面前，却又猛地刹住脚步。
她眼眶通红，嘴唇哆嗦着，想说点什么，却一个字都挤不出来。
她只是死死地盯着他，仿佛要确认他是不是真的毫发无伤。
林渊对她安抚地点点头。
他先走到一旁，对王坤沉声道：
“王叔，今天这个人情我记下了。”
“七天之内，一定把宝药带回来。”
“林小友太客气了！”
“举手之劳！”
“你和小北没事就好！”
王坤笑得满脸褶子，心里跟明镜似的，这年轻人背后绝对有通天的能量。
送走王坤和南区局长，林渊这才转身，走向顾小北母女。
路灯下，顾小北就那么静静地看着他。
那双漂亮的眼睛里，后怕、感激、震惊，种种情绪交织翻涌，最终都沉淀成一种她自己都未曾察觉的、深深的依赖。
“阿姨，小北，我们先回去。”
林渊打破了沉默。
“那个叫李翠翠的，恐怕只是个被人推出来的棋子。”
苏曼君的身体晃了一下，顾小北连忙扶住她。
“怎么说？”

“很简单，我的证据足够清晰，本该录完口供就走。”
“但有人想把我扣下，这说明对方的能量不小，一个普通的工厂女工，没这个本事。”
这番话像一盆冰水，浇灭了苏曼君心中最后一丝侥幸。
她脸色惨白，喃喃道：
“我真是瞎了眼……”
“可她人已经找不到了……”
林渊没再多说。
他不想总是动用王坤的人情。
人情债用一次薄一分，用多了，在之后的交易里就会失去主动权。
在修真界如此，在地球也一样。
回到清秀苑小区那间被砸得不成样子的屋子，三人的心情才算真正平复下来。
“林渊，食品加工厂的事，我明天就去找地方！”
顾小北看着林渊，眼神里重新燃起了斗志，仿佛只有拼命做事，才能回报他一二。
“厂房不急。”
林渊摆了摆手。
content_en:
When Lin Yuan walked out of the branch door unharmed, Gu Xiaobei, who was waiting under the streetlight, finally felt his heart hanging in his throat fall back.
She rushed forward quickly and stopped suddenly when she reached Lin Yuan.
Her eyes were red and her lips were trembling. She wanted to say something, but she couldn't squeeze out a word.
She just stared at him, as if to confirm whether he was really unharmed.
Lin Yuan nodded comfortingly to her.
He walked aside first and said to Wang Kun in a deep voice:
"Uncle Wang, I will remember this favor today."
"We must bring the precious medicine back within seven days."
"Young friend Lin is so polite!"
"Easy to do!"
"As long as you and Xiaobei are fine!"
Wang Kun smiled with wrinkles all over his face, and felt like a mirror in his heart. There was definitely a sky-high energy behind this young man.
After seeing off Wang Kun and the Southern District Director, Lin Yuan turned around and walked towards Gu Xiaobei and his daughter.
Under the streetlight, Gu Xiaobei just looked at him quietly.
In those beautiful eyes, fear, gratitude, shock, all kinds of emotions were intertwined, and eventually settled into a deep dependence that she was unaware of.
"Auntie, Xiaobei, let's go back first."
Lin Yuan broke the silence.
"That person named Li Cuicui is probably just a chess piece that was pushed out."
Su Manjun's body swayed, and Gu Xiaobei quickly supported her.
"How to say?"
"It's very simple. My evidence is clear enough. I should have just recorded the confession and left."
"But someone wants to detain me, which shows that the other person has a lot of energy. An ordinary female factory worker does not have this ability."
These words were like a basin of ice water, extinguishing the last trace of luck in Su Manjun's heart.
She turned pale and murmured:
"I'm really blind..."
"But she can't be found..."
Lin Yuan said no more.
He didn't want to always use Wang Kun's favor.
If you use it too much, you will lose the initiative in subsequent transactions.
This is true in the world of cultivation, and it is the same on earth.
After returning to the smashed house in Qingxiuyuan Community, the three of them finally calmed down.
"Lin Yuan, regarding the food processing factory, I will find a place tomorrow!"
Gu Xiaobei looked at Lin Yuan, his fighting spirit rekindled in his eyes, as if he could only repay him by working hard.
"The factory is not in a hurry."
Lin Yuan waved his hand.
